title: feat(spec, plugin-email): IEmailService.isConfigured() answers whether mail is delivered
body:
Closes #25065
Clause-②: yes (widening: an optional member on `IEmailService`)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

- **Contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`): `IEmailService` gains one OPTIONAL member, `isConfigured?(): boolean`, with the same name and shape as `ISmsService.isConfigured()`. Its TSDoc says: `true` means the active transport hands mail to a real delivery provider; `false` means no mail leaves the process (sends still resolve and audit); a `log` transport is never delivering, in any environment; the answer is read at call time and follows runtime transport swaps; consumers treat an ABSENT member as unknown and must never read it as delivering.
- **Implementation** (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`): `EmailService.isConfigured()` returns `false` while the active transport is the `LogTransport` and `true` for any other transport. It reads the live transport on every call, so it follows `setTransport` swaps, including the ones the plugin makes from the `mail` settings namespace.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` + `@objectstack/plugin-email` at `patch`. Under ruling A (#25105, landed in #25114) the level follows the metadata protocol only. `IEmailService` is a service contract, not an authorable key, value or metadata type, so the kind is `none` and the level is `patch`. The `Clause-②` widening line stays as the claim states it.
- **Out of this PR**: no consumer reads the member yet. The sign-up path in #25060 and the `plugin-auth` readers (`hasEmailTransport()` / `isEmailServiceAvailable()`) are out of this claim. #25060 remains open.

## Tests (final head `1fe7845d18`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: 36 files / 649 tests passed. `typecheck` (tsc + test typecheck) exit 0.
- New plugin-email cases: log transport gives false; live transport gives true; runtime swap log to live to log; registered plugin service on the default boot gives false; saving SMTP settings turns it true; swapping SMTP to Resend stays true.
- Spec: `src/contracts/email-service.test.ts` passes 6/6. The type test pins that the member is optional (an implementation without it stays assignable), and uses `@ts-expect-error` on a non-boolean answer. `typecheck`, including `check:test-typecheck`, exits 0, so that directive is compiled. `test:repo`: 72 files / 1237 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date against a freshly built dist. No baseline moved, so the api-surface snapshot does not record interface members.
- Ablation: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the `isConfigured` body. The subject is imported from `src` through relative paths, so there is no dist leg. Leg 1 (`return true`) and leg 2 (`return false`) each ran with the marker on disk (1 hit, anchor 0 hits). Each turned 4 of the new tests red (2 files failed, 4 failed / 50 passed). Both restores were verified: blob equals the HEAD blob `279f67336b27` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (90 commands, plus the 5 roster families under touched directories) all exited 0. The changeset gates were re-run after the regrade commit.
